name: Tutoring effects were stronger on average for teachers and paraprofessionals than for nonprofessional and parent tutors.
description: Nickow, Oreopoulos and Quan (2020) report this comparison in the meta-analysis abstract. It is an average subgroup pattern across heterogeneous experiments, not a guarantee for every tutor or program.

name: Tutoring effects were strongest on average among earlier grades.
description: Nickow, Oreopoulos and Quan (2020) report stronger average effects among earlier grades. The comparison spans different subjects, programs and study settings and does not identify one universal grade cutoff.

name: Tutoring conducted during school had larger average impacts than tutoring conducted after school.
description: Nickow, Oreopoulos and Quan (2020) report this setting comparison in the meta-analysis abstract. The result is an average association across experimental programs, not a cost-adjusted ranking of delivery settings.
